name: pilot: local Docker, every factor can be varied on a laptop

factors.name: ensemble_size
factors.why: quorum cost: gamma and beta in the Stage I fits

factors.name: clients
factors.why: below the saturation knee vs well past it

factors.name: force_sync
factors.why: zookeeper.forceSync=no removes the fsync: directly tests whether the log-sync stage is behind alpha

factors.name: payload_bytes
factors.why: bytes logged and replicated per write

factors.name: cpu_quota
factors.why: server CPU headroom (docker --cpus): tests whether CPU rather than disk limits the pipeline

factors.name: log_device
factors.why: txn log on disk vs RAM (tmpfs): local stand-in for a faster log disk; on GCE this becomes pd-balanced vs pd-ssd
